feature.tests_cover: sidecar order until points run out; 5-byte packet layout; resume on next level-up + idempotent stop; ack reflection and failure-ack non-advance; 0x00bd seeding; negative/unknown points and param-24 non-spendability; build_current query with gear legs; bounded batching; setup-before-script ordering seam; all twin frames accepted by production NativeGameplayTracker.consume_snapshot (framing consistency, incl. currently-ignored 0x00bc/0x00bd); sidecar validation rejects; w39-shaped full allocation (48 pts -> str 9 dex 9, 16 held); brain-facing observation includes status_points
